purpose: Cross-song exploratory evaluation of the unchanged qualified coherence intervention, after a matched-attack diagnostic on the prior masters.

source.selection: Existing project reference from the mission priority list; 131.115s fits qualified <=180s geometry and previous 1536MiB resource ceiling. No candidate-output search. Contrast to the first song is exploratory, not a measured genre classification.

shared_configuration: Recorded Smooth-style settings: OpenCL, Euler8, 10s chunks/2s overlap, ph-lie-v2, clock-transient-punch, kick-transient-guard, quiet-mid-denoise, -13LUFS/-1dBTP; no auto-tune or force-specialists; default cache/host batch unchanged.
gates: Prior fixed-input-window attack diagnostic must complete with synthetic controls and validated source/output alignment; interpret rather than retune against owner feedback.
Verify original input, decoded PCM geometry, frozen binary, model and prior qualification receipts.
Every output finite, exact rate/channel/frame geometry, native true peak <= -0.99dBTP and abs(target shortfall) <=0.1LU.
Native mono compatibility, known-band and transient-timing checks all true.
Settings identical except declared requested/applied flags and CLI provenance; same input/models/binary.
Control has no applied coherence; candidate actually applies coherence and differs from control; preserve routing abstention.
Any HALT, process failure, memory or time excess latches this fresh session; no automatic retry or cap increase.

listening.selection: Fixed 48..78s timestamp matching previous protocol convention; full song. No favorable passage search.
listening.matching: Existing attenuation-only matching_target with peak headroom; measured encoded paired difference <=0.15LU. No added limiter or remastering.
listening.response: Unchanged categorical CSV plus separate free-text notes, easy indistinguishable/abstain, comfortable playback-level check before fixed settings.
listening.blinding: Fresh private random seed and concealed assignments. Prior mechanism knowledge remains; no naive-expectation claim.

interpretation: Eligibility for exploratory owner listening only. Prior identity-control confound, post-reveal subjective tradeoff, procedural target-error conflict and false healthy edits remain. No production promotion, new model, solver, training or speed claim.
